title: Data Engineer
description_text:
Who we are
Intrepid Asia is a leading Ecommerce and Digital Solutions Provider in South East Asia. We offer end-to-end omni-channel ecommerce management, Livestreaming, Video production & Affiliate Management for Social Commerce, plus full funnel Digital Marketing Services and advanced Market Intelligence, all powered by state-of-the-art in-house Technology to our client base of leading international brands across all key marketplaces and social platforms in all 6 SEA countries. Brands love our regional presence, our excellent data-driven, growth-focused services, enabled by the industry's strongest team, and our advanced marketing and tech capabilities.

We are growing rapidly, and as the exclusive partner of Flywheel in SEA, we offer many exciting opportunities to work with leading brands across multiple categories and key industry players. By joining us, you will work on the cutting edge of digital and social commerce in SEA, and experience what it takes to drive a successful ecommerce business end-to-end.
The part you will play
We are looking for a motivated Data Engineer to join our Data Engineering team and support the reliability and growth of our data pipelines and warehouses. You'll work closely with senior data engineers, the Data Engineering Manager, and the BI Data Analyst team, building hands-on experience across our stack while contributing to real production pipelines that power decision-making for our brand clients across SEA. Our current stack includes Google BigQuery, StarRocks, Airflow, dbt, Cube.dev (semantic layer), Looker Studio, and Apache Superset.
This is a great opportunity for someone with a couple of years of data engineering experience who wants to deepen their skills in a fast-paced, agile environment and grow toward more senior ownership over time.
As a Data Engineer, you will
- Data Pipeline Development
- Build, maintain, and troubleshoot ETL/ELT pipelines orchestrated with Apache Airflow under the guidance of senior engineers.
- Write and optimize SQL transformations across StarRocks and Google BigQuery.
- Support building and maintaining in Airflow job and dbt models for data transformation, following team standards for testing and documentation.
- Support ingestion of data from multiple marketplace and social commerce platforms into our warehouse.
- Data Quality & Monitoring
- Implement and maintain data quality checks against defined metrics and SLAs for assigned datasets.
- Monitor pipeline runs, investigate failures, and escalate or resolve issues with support from senior team members.
- Collaboration & Learning
- Work with analysts and senior data engineers to understand data requirements and translate them into pipeline logic.
- Participate in Agile ceremonies (Scrum/Kanban) sprint planning, stand-ups, retros.
- Follow and help apply team conventions for pipeline standardization, naming, and documentation.
- Continuously build proficiency with the team's modern data stack and DataOps practices (version control, code review, testing).

Requirements:
Must-have:
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
- 2+ years of hands-on experience in data engineering, data pipelines, or a closely related role.
- Proven Python & SQL proficiency
- Hands-on experience with Apache Airflow or a comparable workflow orchestration tool.
- Working proficiency in Python (e.g., pandas, scripting for data workflows).
- Familiarity with cloud data warehouses (Google BigQuery preferred; Snowflake, Azure Synapse, Databricks, or similar also considered).
- Familiarity with OLTP databases such as MySQL or Postgres.
- Basic understanding of ETL/ELT design patterns and data modelling concepts.
Nice-to-have:
- Exposure to dbt (or similar transformation tools) for building and testing data models.
- Exposure to OLAP databases (StarRocks, ClickHouse, or similar).
- Familiarity with a semantic layer tool (e.g., Cube.dev) or BI/reporting tools (Looker Studio, Apache Superset).
- Experience working in an Agile/Scrum environment.
- Eagerness to learn, take ownership of assigned tasks, and grow into a more senior data engineering role.

title: Full Stack Developer - (Public Sector)
description_text:
At Xtremax, you'll help build and enhance a modern cloud-native content management platform used by public sector organisations to create, manage and publish secure digital services. The platform is designed for non-technical users, making it easier for organisations to deliver high-quality digital experiences while meeting enterprise standards for scalability, security and reliability.
As a Full Stack Developer, you'll develop both frontend and backend capabilities using React, TypeScript and Node.js, working on features such as content management, publishing workflows, cloud-based infrastructure and automation. You'll also contribute to software quality through automated testing, helping ensure every release is reliable and production-ready.
Working alongside Product Managers, UX Designers, Architects, Security Engineers, and DevOps teams, you'll be involved in designing scalable solutions, improving engineering practices and exploring emerging technologies including AI-assisted capabilities within a modern SaaS environment.

Responsibilities
- Design, develop and maintain scalable full stack features using React.js, TypeScript and NestJS.
- Build and enhance multi-tenant platform capabilities including content management, publishing workflows and layout composition.
- Design PostgreSQL database schemas, optimise queries and manage database migrations.
- Develop cloud-enabled solutions leveraging AWS services such as S3, CloudFront and Lambda.
- Write and maintain automated unit, integration and end-to-end tests using Jest, Supertest and Playwright.
- Design comprehensive test cases to validate new features and ensure high software quality.
- Support CI/CD pipelines through GitLab CI and contribute to continuous delivery practices.
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define technical solutions, review designs and deliver secure, reliable software.
- Contribute to AI-assisted product capabilities while ensuring appropriate review and governance processes.
- Continuously improve engineering standards, testing practices and overall platform reliability.

Requirements:
- Degree or Diploma in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering or a related discipline.
- Minimum 4 years of professional software engineering experience.
- Strong experience with TypeScript, Node.js and backend API development.
- Experience with React.js for modern web application development.
- Experience with NestJS or similar backend frameworks such as Express or Fastify.
- Strong understanding of PostgreSQL, relational database design and query optimisation.
- Experience working with cloud platforms, preferably AWS.
- Experience writing automated unit, integration and end-to-end tests.
- Ability to design comprehensive test scenarios for new product features.
- Strong written communication skills and experience working with cross-functional stakeholders.

Preferred
- Experience building multi-tenant SaaS platforms.
- Familiarity with content versioning/diffing approaches (e.g. JSON Patch, OT/CRDT concepts).
- Familiarity with IAM or Role-Based Access Control (RBAC).
- Experience integrating AI or LLM capabilities into production applications.
- Exposure to GitLab CI/CD and modern DevOps practices.

Why Join Us
- 🌍 Meaningful impact — contribute to digital projects that serve government and enterprise clients.
- 💡 Culture of learning — we value curiosity, open communication, and taking ownership.

title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer
description_text:
We are building a data-intensive M&A deal-tracking platform - a web application where investment bankers manage pipelines, process documents, and surface AI-driven insights. We're looking for a Senior Full-Stack Engineer who is equally comfortable shipping polished React UIs and designing backend systems that handle document ingestion, async job pipelines, and AI agent orchestration.
Key Responsibilities
- Build & maintain the full stack - from Next.js App Router pages and API routes through to the PostgreSQL schema, Drizzle migrations, and background job workers
- Own AI-powered features - integrate and extend LangGraph agents (document classification, structured extraction, company enrichment) using the Anthropic SDK and Vercel AI SDK
- Design backend systems - model new domain concepts in Drizzle ORM, write service and repository layers following clean architecture, and queue async work through the jobs table
- Drive quality - write unit tests (Vitest) and Playwright e2e tests for every feature; participate in code reviews
- Collaborate across functions - translate business requirements from the deal team into technical specs, and work with product on iterative feature releases gated behind feature flags

Requirements:
Must-Have Skills:
- 5+ years of full-stack experience; strong in React, Next.js App Router, and TypeScript (strict mode)
- Solid backend skills: RESTful API design, relational database modeling (PostgreSQL), and ORM usage (Drizzle or Prisma/TypeORM)
- Experience wiring up AI SDK or LangGraph — prompt engineering, tool/function calling, streaming responses
- Familiarity with async job patterns — queuing work, tracking state in a jobs table, handling retries
- Proficiency with Tailwind CSS and component libraries (Radix UI / shadcn/ui)
- Experience with cloud infra on AWS (S3, SES, RDS) or equivalent

Nice-to-Have:
- Multi-agent orchestration experience
- Graph database exposure (Neo4j)
- Terraform or infrastructure-as-code
- Vercel platform (feature flags, Edge Config, Fluid Compute)
- Python for data pipeline work

Stack:
Next.js 16 · TypeScript · Drizzle ORM · PostgreSQL · Neo4j · LangGraph · Anthropic Claude · Vercel AI SDK · AWS (S3 / SES / RDS) · Tailwind CSS · Recharts · React Force Graph · Vitest · Playwright · Vercel

title: Senior DevOps Engineer / Cloud Engineer
description_text:
This role is open only to candidates currently based in Thailand or Indonesia, with a hybrid arrangement in Bangkok and a remote arrangement in Indonesia.

Cube is looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer / Cloud Engineer to help us build, automate, and manage the cloud infrastructure and delivery pipelines behind our products.
You will design and maintain secure, scalable, highly available, and cost-efficient infrastructure while enabling our engineering teams to deliver software and data pipelines reliably. You will work closely with the Software Engineering and Data Engineering teams to build and improve our infrastructure and operational practices.

Responsibilities
- Design, implement, and manage secure, scalable, highly available, and cost-efficient cloud infrastructure and architectures.
- Provision, manage, and automate infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and automation tools.
- Design, build, and maintain CI/CD pipelines to enable reliable and automated software delivery.
- Deploy, manage, and maintain containerized workloads and orchestration platforms, including Kubernetes and cloud container services.
- Manage and maintain cloud networking, databases, monitoring, logging, alerting, backups, and disaster recovery infrastructure.
- Perform day-to-day infrastructure operations, troubleshoot technical issues, respond to incidents, and contribute to post-incident reviews.
- Automate repetitive operational tasks and continuously improve infrastructure reliability, scalability, performance, and cost efficiency.
- Collaborate closely with the Software Engineering and Data Engineering teams to design and deliver reliable, practical infrastructure solutions.
- Maintain clear technical documentation, runbooks, and operational processes.
- Support the migration and modernization of legacy systems and infrastructure.

Requirements:
- 5+ years of professional experience in DevOps, Cloud Engineering, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), or a similar role.
- Strong experience administering Linux servers and managing cloud infrastructure, preferably AWS.
- Hands-on experience designing and managing infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code (IaC), such as Terraform, Ansible, or CloudFormation.
- Hands-on experience managing Docker containers and Kubernetes or similar container orchestration platforms.
- Hands-on experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines and working with Git-based development workflows.
- Good understanding of cloud networking concepts, including VPCs/VNets, subnets, routing, VPNs, DNS, and load balancers.
- Hands-on experience with monitoring, logging, alerting, and observability systems.
- Working knowledge of commonly used databases, such as MySQL or PostgreSQL.
- Ability to write basic Bash, Python, or similar scripts for automation and operational tasks.
- Proven experience troubleshooting infrastructure and production issues and working effectively across engineering teams.
- Experience migrating, modernizing, or transitioning legacy systems and infrastructure.
- Good to have experience with data analytics and big-data services.
- Infrastructure or cloud certifications are a plus.

title: Accounting Analyst
description_text:
Amartha is a technology company focused on creating shared prosperity by developing digital financial solutions for the grassroots economy. Founded in 2010 as a microfinance institution, Amartha connects rural, women-led micro-enterprises with affordable capital. Amartha is expanding as a tech company, building a microfinance ecosystem that connects to the growing digital economy through capital, investment, and payment services. By boosting the competitiveness of micro and small entrepreneurs, Amartha empowers women-led MSMEs, creates jobs, and fosters inclusive economic growth.

About the role
As our Accounting Analyst, you will manage financial records, perform account reconciliations, and maintain accurate supporting documentation. You will support month-end and year-end closing activities, ensure compliance with accounting standards and company policies, prepare financial reports, and work closely with internal stakeholders to maintain the accuracy and integrity of financial data while continuously improving accounting processes.

Responsibilities

1. Monthly Closing & Financial Reporting
- Perform monthly closing activities for lending business entities.
- Prepare journal entries, accruals, amortization, reclass, and adjustment entries.
- Prepare monthly balance sheet schedules and P&L analysis.
- Ensure timely and accurate submission of monthly financial statements.

2. Loan & Revenue Accounting
- Handle accounting treatment for loan disbursement, repayment, outstanding principal, interest income, admin fee, platform fee, and other lending-related revenue.
- Reconcile loan system data against GL, bank statement, and operational reports.
- Review revenue recognition accuracy, including accrued revenue, cash repayment, and fee amortization where applicable.

3. Reconciliation & Control
- Perform daily/monthly reconciliation for bank accounts, escrow accounts, borrower/lender balances, AR/AP, settlement accounts, and suspense accounts.
- Investigate unreconciled items and coordinate with product, data, operation, treasury, and business teams.
- Maintain clean aging and proper documentation for all reconciling items.

4. ECL, Provision & Write-Off Support
- Support ECL calculation, loan impairment booking, write-off, recovery, and related accounting entries.
- Work closely with risk/data team to validate loan portfolio movement and DPD information.
- Prepare supporting schedules for auditors and management review.

5. Audit & Compliance Support
- Prepare audit schedules, supporting documents, and explanation for external auditors.
- Support OJK/regulatory reporting requirements where relevant.
- Ensure accounting treatment is aligned with PSAK/IFRS and company policy.

6. Process Improvement
- Improve closing checklist, reconciliation templates, and accounting SOP.
- Identify accounting gaps in lending product flow and propose control improvements.
- Support system enhancement or automation for accounting and reconciliation process.

Requirements:
- Minimum 2 years experience in accounting/audit/finance.
- Experience in financial services, preferably P2P lending, multifinance, bank, leasing, or fintech.
- Strong understanding of PSAK/IFRS, especially financial instruments, revenue recognition, accruals, and impairment/ECL.
- Strong reconciliation skill: bank, GL, loan system, escrow, AR/AP, settlement.
- Strong Excel/Google Sheets skill: pivot, lookup, sumifs, data validation, aging, reconciliation.
- Comfortable working with high-volume transaction data.
- Able to prepare audit schedules and explain accounting treatment to auditors.
- Detail-oriented, structured, and able to meet tight monthly closing deadlines.

Nice to Have
- Big 4 / mid-tier audit background.
- Experience with SAP or other ERP.
- Familiar with SQL / Looker / basic data extraction.
- Understanding of OJK lending/multifinance reporting.
- Experience with intercompany transactions and consolidation support.

At Amartha, we are dedicated to creating a workplace that celebrates diversity, ensures equity, and fosters inclusion. We believe that diverse perspectives—shaped by factors such as gender, age, race, ethnicity, education, culture, and life experiences—drive innovation and growth.
We actively welcome individuals from all backgrounds to join us in building an environment where everyone feels respected, valued, and empowered. Our commitment is to provide equal opportunities and foster a sense of belonging that enables our employees to thrive and make meaningful contributions.

title: Lead Auditor
description_text:
- Lead risk-based audits across Frontier Material Sciences interfaces, covering finance, operations, procurement, manufacturing, quality, technology and compliance
- Establish an IPO-ready internal-control framework, including data integrity, product traceability, IT controls and cross-border governance
- Identify control gaps, value leakage and operational risks, then drive timely remediation with accountable business owner.
- Provide independent assurance and concise risk insights to FMS leadership, Group Internal Audit and the Audit Committee.

Requirements:
- 8–12 years’ experience in internal audit, risk or assurance, preferably within manufacturing, chemicals, semiconductor, supply chain or Big Four.
- Strong knowledge of ERP, ITGC, data analytics, procurement, inventory, quality management and manufacturing controls.
- Professional certification such as CIA, CPA, CA or CISA is preferred, with experience supporting IPO or investor due diligence.
- Strong investigation, stakeholder-management and report-writing capability across multinational and cross-functional environments.

title: Data Analyst
description_text:
This is a hybrid role based in our Bangkok office, with a remote arrangement for candidates based in Indonesia.
We are seeking a motivated and detail-oriented Data Analyst to join our growing team. This role is ideal for fresh graduates or candidates with up to 2 years of experience who are eager to build a career in data and e-commerce.

As a Data Analyst, you will work with real-world datasets to uncover trends, support client reporting, and contribute to meaningful insights in one of the fastest-growing sectors in Southeast Asia.

Responsibilities
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather and understand data and business requirements
- Transform and clean data using Python (SQL is a plus)
- Perform exploratory data analysis to identify trends, patterns, and anomalies
- Assist in developing and implementing data models and algorithms
- Analyze and interpret complex datasets to surface key metrics and statistical insights reports to communicate findings effectively

Requirements:
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a basic understanding of statistics and data interpretation
- Proficiency in Python, Google Sheets, and Excel is essential; SQL knowledge is a plus
- Experience with data warehouse platforms such as Snowflake, Amazon Athena, or Google BigQuery is a plus
- Enthusiastic self-starter with a strong desire to learn and grow in the data field
- Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment and adapting quickly to change
- Passionate about e-commerce, with strong communication and collaboration skills
- A Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field (e.g., Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, etc.) is preferred but not required.

title: Senior Data Scientist - Credit Risk
description_text:
Funding Societies | Modalku is the largest SME digital finance platform in Southeast Asia. We are licensed and operating in Singapore, Indonesia, Thailand, Malaysia and Vietnam, and backed by Sequoia India (Peak XV), Softbank Vision Fund, Khazanah and SMBC bank amongst many others. Funding Societies | Modalku provides business financing to small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs), which is funded by individual and institutional investors, as well as payments solutions to SMEs and consumers.

Here at Funding Societies | Modalku we live by our core values GETFS:
- Grow Relentlessly: Strive to become our best, most authentic selves.
- Enable Teamwork, Disable Politics: Only by forging togetherness, we help each other succeed.
- Test Measure Act: Stay curious and reinvent ourselves, through innovation and experimentation.
- Focus on Impact: Create impact through bias for action and tangible results.
- Serve with Obsession: Build win-win relationships for the long-term by having a customer obsession.
Role Overview
We are seeking a highly motivated and skilled Senior Data Scientist to join our dynamic team. You will work with a diverse team of experts in a collaborative and innovative environment, analysing complex datasets, developing predictive models, and providing insights that drive business decisions.
Key Responsibilities
- Model Development & Deployment: Design, build, and productionise machine learning models for credit scoring, risk profiling, fraud detection, and customer segmentation, calibrating existing scoring logic and business rules to improve predictive performance.
- Model Governance & Documentation: Prepare and maintain model documentation (data sources, features, assumptions) and drive models through internal review, credit review, and sign-off ahead of deployment, ensuring models remain interpretable, robust, and aligned with regulatory standards.
- Analytical Insights & Impact: Perform deep-dive analyses to uncover trends and actionable insights that improve model performance and product strategy, translating findings into clear, data-driven narratives and building self-serve tools, dashboards, and model monitoring frameworks for transparency and measurable impact.
- Model Infrastructure & MLOps: Build and maintain scalable model pipelines and infrastructure supporting the end-to-end lifecycle (training, validation, deployment, monitoring), and automate workflows to reduce operational overhead and enhance reproducibility and governance.
- Leadership & Mentorship: Mentor junior data scientists and analysts through structured guidance and technical reviews, and lead high-impact data science initiatives from problem scoping to final delivery.

Requirements:
- 5+ years of experience in data science, preferably within the fintech or financial services industry.
- Proven experience developing and deploying machine learning models in a production environment.
- Strong background in statistical analysis and machine learning.
- Expertise in credit modelling and risk management is an added advantage.
- Experience navigating formal model governance processes (documentation, committee review, sign-off) in a regulated environment.
- Comfort incorporating AI-assisted tools (e.g. code generation, automated documentation) into day-to-day model development.

title: Staff Research Engineer - AI & Machine Learning
description_text:
About Gramian
Gramian Consultancy is a boutique consultancy specializing in IT professional services and engineering talent solutions. With a strong background in software engineering and leadership, we help companies build high-performing teams by matching them with professionals who truly fit their needs.

About the Role
We are looking for a Staff Research Engineer to advance research and practical innovation in frontier AI systems. You will investigate high-impact questions, design rigorous experiments, build research-grade prototypes and tooling, and collaborate across Research, Engineering, Product, and Operations teams.
The role focuses on areas including synthetic and agentic data generation, reinforcement learning, post-training, model understanding, benchmarks, and AI evaluation. You will help translate promising research ideas into scalable applications and improvements to AI products and systems.

SENIORITY: Staff level — 7+ years

Key Responsibilities
- Investigate the capabilities, limitations, and training methods of frontier AI systems.
- Formulate research questions that inform AI products, platforms, and technical strategy.
- Explore new approaches to synthetic and agentic data generation, reinforcement learning, post-training, model understanding, benchmarks, and evaluation.
- Stay current with advances in machine learning and identify opportunities for meaningful technical contributions.
- Develop research-grade datasets, experiments, prototypes, tooling, and evaluation frameworks.
- Train, test, and evaluate models using modern AI and machine learning tools.
- Analyze experimental results and develop clear, evidence-based conclusions.
- Establish rigorous practices for data quality, reproducibility, experimental design, and evaluation.
- Iterate rapidly from research hypotheses to validated technical insights.
- Collaborate with Research, Engineering, Product, and Operations teams to translate findings into practical applications.
- Communicate technical findings to both specialized and cross-functional audiences.
- Contribute to technical reports, publications, open-source projects, workshops, or conferences where appropriate.
- Mentor engineers and researchers and contribute to technical discussions and peer review.

Requirements:
- Ph.D. or Master’s degree in Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Computer Science, or a closely related technical field.
- 7+ years of professional experience, including significant research engineering experience in machine learning or frontier AI systems.
- Strong foundations in machine learning and hands-on experience designing experiments, training models, evaluating models, or developing AI systems.
- Demonstrated research experience in at least one of the following:
- Synthetic or agentic data generation
- Reinforcement learning or post-training
- Model understanding
- AI evaluation
- AI benchmarks
- AI agents or tool-using systems
- Strong Python programming skills with the ability to implement, test, and iterate quickly in research environments.
- Experience with modern AI/ML frameworks, tooling, and research workflows.
- Strong scientific judgment around experimental rigor, data quality, reproducibility, and evidence-based decision-making.
- Excellent technical communication skills and ability to work independently across research and engineering teams.

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer, AI Builder
description_text:
Insurance is one of the world's largest industries and one of the most painful to interact with. Paper forms. Sluggish call centres. Three-week underwriting cycles. Claims that vanish into queues. We are rebuilding all of it on top of a modern platform and AI agents that actually do the work, not pretend to.
You will not be picking up tickets. You will be deciding what to build, prototyping it on Monday, shipping a draft to a real customer by Friday, and improving it from real usage. We expect you to push the product, the codebase, and the way we work.
Why This Role Exists
We are looking for someone who treats AI as a creative material, not a feature on a roadmap. The next year of insurance is being defined right now. What gets automated, what gets reimagined, what gets thrown out. We want builders who want to be in that room and ship the answer.
The team is small. The mandate is large. If your highest-energy work has historically come from solving real problems end to end, this is the seat.
What You Will Do
- Own outcomes, not tickets. Pick the biggest lever for our customers each sprint and drive it to live. Surface the next one yourself.
- Build with AI as a primary tool, not a chatbot bolt-on. OCR, document understanding, generation, agent loops, evaluation harnesses. You decide where each fits.
- Ship prototypes fast, then make them production-grade. A working demo on day three beats a perfect plan on day ten.
- Work directly with customers. You will see real claims, real underwriting screens, real broker workflows. You will watch users hit dead ends and decide what to fix.
- Raise the bar on the codebase. Reviews, refactors, testability, observability. Not as policy, as habit.
- Push the team forward. Skills, agents, internal tools, engineering standards. Propose them, build them, get them adopted.
Who You Are
- You ship. Ideas without execution do not count for you.
- High agency. You do not wait for a card to be assigned. You see what is worth doing and you start.
- Strong opinions, loosely held. You make calls with incomplete information and change your mind when the evidence shifts.
- Curious about the domain. Insurance is messy and full of weird incentives. That intrigues you, not annoys you.
- Fluent with AI. You have shipped something real with LLMs or agents. You know where the magic ends and where you have to engineer carefully.
- Care about humans on the other end. Insurance done right gives people peace of mind in their worst weeks. That is the point.
Your Toolbox
We use Node.js + TypeScript + Nest.js on the back end, Vue (and some React) on the front end, GraphQL, MongoDB, Docker, AWS. AI work spans OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, plus a growing set of in-house skills and agents. You do not need to have used every piece. You do need to be the kind of engineer who picks up a new tool and is shipping with it within the week.
What We Expect at This Level
- 6+ years building production systems. Track record of complex, customer-facing software shipped, not just maintained.
- Real AI experience. You have built and shipped at least one substantive AI-driven feature. POCs that died in a notebook do not count here.
- Strong fundamentals. OO, design patterns, testing, web security, performance. You do not need a refresher.
- Cloud comfort. AWS, Azure, or GCP. At least one in depth, the rest enough to hold a conversation.
- Communication. You can explain a tradeoff to a non-technical stakeholder in two minutes and to an engineer in one.
Not Suitable for the Role If…
- You prefer tickets assigned to you over choosing what to build.
- You measure your work in lines of code, not outcomes.
- You see AI as a buzzword to put on your CV rather than a tool you have actually used in anger.
- You want a process-heavy environment with detailed specs handed down from product.
- You are looking for a maintenance role on a finished platform.
Why CoverGo
Insurance is the rare industry where AI can save people hours of their worst weeks. We are already shipping AI-powered claims, underwriting, distribution, and document automation to enterprise carriers across five continents. The platform is real. The customers are real. The next chapter is yours to help write.
Why You'll Love Working Here
- 100% Remote Work
- Paid Annual Leave
- Annual Performance Bonus
- Remote Work Allowance
- Anniversary Bonus
- Health Insurance
- Company Activities and Events
- Learning and Development Plan
CoverGo Company Video

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer, AI Builder
description_text:
Insurance is one of the world's largest industries and one of the most painful to interact with. Paper forms. Sluggish call centres. Three-week underwriting cycles. Claims that vanish into queues. We are rebuilding all of it on top of a modern platform and AI agents that actually do the work, not pretend to.
You will not be picking up tickets. You will be deciding what to build, prototyping it on Monday, shipping a draft to a real customer by Friday, and improving it from real usage. We expect you to push the product, the codebase, and the way we work.
Why This Role Exists
We are looking for someone who treats AI as a creative material, not a feature on a roadmap. The next year of insurance is being defined right now. What gets automated, what gets reimagined, what gets thrown out. We want builders who want to be in that room and ship the answer.
The team is small. The mandate is large. If your highest-energy work has historically come from solving real problems end to end, this is the seat.
What You Will Do
- Own outcomes, not tickets. Pick the biggest lever for our customers each sprint and drive it to live. Surface the next one yourself.
- Build with AI as a primary tool, not a chatbot bolt-on. OCR, document understanding, generation, agent loops, evaluation harnesses. You decide where each fits.
- Ship prototypes fast, then make them production-grade. A working demo on day three beats a perfect plan on day ten.
- Work directly with customers. You will see real claims, real underwriting screens, real broker workflows. You will watch users hit dead ends and decide what to fix.
- Raise the bar on the codebase. Reviews, refactors, testability, observability. Not as policy, as habit.
- Push the team forward. Skills, agents, internal tools, engineering standards. Propose them, build them, get them adopted.
Who You Are
- You ship. Ideas without execution do not count for you.
- High agency. You do not wait for a card to be assigned. You see what is worth doing and you start.
- Strong opinions, loosely held. You make calls with incomplete information and change your mind when the evidence shifts.
- Curious about the domain. Insurance is messy and full of weird incentives. That intrigues you, not annoys you.
- Fluent with AI. You have shipped something real with LLMs or agents. You know where the magic ends and where you have to engineer carefully.
- Care about humans on the other end. Insurance done right gives people peace of mind in their worst weeks. That is the point.
Your Toolbox
We use Node.js + TypeScript + Nest.js on the back end, Vue (and some React) on the front end, GraphQL, MongoDB, Docker, AWS. AI work spans OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, plus a growing set of in-house skills and agents. You do not need to have used every piece. You do need to be the kind of engineer who picks up a new tool and is shipping with it within the week.
What We Expect at This Level
- 6+ years building production systems. Track record of complex, customer-facing software shipped, not just maintained.
- Real AI experience. You have built and shipped at least one substantive AI-driven feature. POCs that died in a notebook do not count here.
- Strong fundamentals. OO, design patterns, testing, web security, performance. You do not need a refresher.
- Cloud comfort. AWS, Azure, or GCP. At least one in depth, the rest enough to hold a conversation.
- Communication. You can explain a tradeoff to a non-technical stakeholder in two minutes and to an engineer in one.
Not Suitable for the Role If…
- You prefer tickets assigned to you over choosing what to build.
- You measure your work in lines of code, not outcomes.
- You see AI as a buzzword to put on your CV rather than a tool you have actually used in anger.
- You want a process-heavy environment with detailed specs handed down from product.
- You are looking for a maintenance role on a finished platform.
Why CoverGo
Insurance is the rare industry where AI can save people hours of their worst weeks. We are already shipping AI-powered claims, underwriting, distribution, and document automation to enterprise carriers across five continents. The platform is real. The customers are real. The next chapter is yours to help write.
Why You'll Love Working Here
- 100% Remote Work
- Paid Annual Leave
- Annual Performance Bonus
- Remote Work Allowance
- Anniversary Bonus
- Health Insurance
- Company Activities and Events

description_text:

Role Overview
As the Application Security Engineer\Lead, you will serve as the primary authority for ensuring the security, resilience, and integrity of our digital financial services, mobile platforms, and crypto systems. Reporting directly to the Head of Security, you will champion secure software development lifecycle (SSDLC) practices, scale our threat modeling capabilities, and manage security testing programs. You will be responsible for aligning our application defense with the OWASP framework and managing external penetration testing in accordance with CREST standards.

Key Responsibilities
- AppSec Program Leadership: Define and implement the enterprise Application Security strategy, ensuring secure coding practices are embedded across all engineering teams.

- Threat Modeling: Lead architecture review and conduct threat modeling exercises during early product design phases using frameworks like STRIDE, and champion secure coding standards across the engineering ecosystem.
- CREST-Aligned Penetration Testing: Manage the scoping, execution, and remediation tracking of external penetration tests, ensuring all third-party vendors and methodologies adhere strictly to CREST accreditation guidelines.
- Developer Enablement: Design and deliver continuous secure code training programs and champion a network of "Security Champions" within product engineering teams

Requirements:
- Experience: 8+ years of dedicated experience in information security, with at least 3+ years specifically leading application security or product security functions within fintech, digital banking, or e-commerce ecosystem.
- Technical Proficiency: Strong background in software development (e.g., Java, Python, Go, Node.js) and a deep understanding of cloud-native architectures (AWS/GCP, Kubernetes, Docker).
- Mobile & Tooling Expertise: Deep technical knowledge of mobile app vulnerabilities (reverse engineering, certificate pinning, secure storage) and extensive hands-on experience managing security tooling native to GitHub, GitLab and Bitbucket.Proficiency in SAST/DAST/SCA tools such as Chekcmarx, Semgrep, Snyk, Burp Suite Professional, and SonarQube.
- OWASP Mastery: Proven track record of applying OWASP standards to web, mobile, and API layers to systematically reduce application vulnerabilities.
- CREST/Testing Expertise: Clear understanding of CREST penetration testing standards; experience managing or executing CREST-accredited technical security assessments.
- Certifications: Possession of CREST certifications (e.g., CREST Registered/Certified Application Security Analyst) or equivalent expert-level practical certifications (e.g., OSCP, OSWE, CSSLP) is highly preferred.
- Communication: Exceptional capability to articulate complex software vulnerabilities as business risks to product owners and provide actionable technical fixes to engineers.

description_text:
Role Overview
We are looking for a commercially driven Digital Marketing & Growth Lead to lead the development and execution of our digital marketing and influencer strategy in Indonesia.

This role will be responsible for making campaign & promotion strategies both online and offline, building and managing a strong network of KOLs, financial content creators, influencers, trading communities, and relevant digital partners to drive brand awareness, user acquisition, app registrations, account activation, deposits, and overall business growth.
The ideal candidate should have strong knowledge of the Indonesian digital and influencer ecosystem, excellent commercial negotiation skills, and the ability to manage KOL activities based on measurable business performance rather than visibility alone.

Key responsibilities

1. KOL Strategy & Business Growth
- Develop and execute the overall KOL and influencer strategy aligned with the company's business and user acquisition objectives.

2. KOL Acquisition & Relationship Management
- Source, evaluate, approach, and onboard high-potential KOLs and content creators.
- Build and maintain long-term relationships with key KOLs and strategic partners.
- Conduct commercial negotiations covering collaboration fees, deliverables, performance incentives, campaign periods, and contractual terms.
- Develop appropriate collaboration models based on each KOL's audience profile and expected commercial contribution.
- Maintain a healthy KOL portfolio and continuously assess partner quality and performance.

3. Campaign Management
- Lead end-to-end execution of KOL campaigns, including campaign planning, briefing, content coordination, launch, tracking, optimization, and post-campaign evaluation.
- Lead end-to-end execution of online and offline promotional campaigns, including campaign planning, briefing, content coordination, launch, tracking, optimization, and post-campaign evaluation.
- Work closely with KOLs to develop engaging and locally relevant content while maintaining the company's brand positioning.
- Ensure campaigns are launched according to agreed timelines, deliverables, budgets, and performance expectations.
- Coordinate with internal Marketing, Business, Product, Design, Compliance, and Operations teams to ensure smooth campaign execution.
- Identify underperforming campaigns early and implement corrective actions to improve results.

4. Performance & ROI Management
- Establish clear KPIs and performance benchmarks for each KOL and campaign.
- Monitor the complete acquisition funnel, including:
- Reach and engagement
- Traffic and app downloads
- Registrations
- KYC completion
- First-time deposits / funded accounts
- Customer acquisition cost
- Conversion rate
- Customer quality and retention
- Trading activity and overall commercial contribution

5. Market & Competitor Intelligence
- Monitor competitor KOL strategies, campaign activities, influencer partnerships, promotions, and market positioning.
- Stay updated on emerging KOLs, content trends, trading communities, social media platforms, and customer behavior.
- Identify new opportunities that could strengthen the company's competitive position in the Indonesian market.

title: Regional Accountant (Part-Time)
description_text:
ABOUT NEW ENERGY NEXUS
New Energy Nexus (NEX) is an international organization that supports clean energy entrepreneurs through funding, accelerators, and networks. We operate across the United States, China, India, Southeast Asia, and East Africa, with a vision of an abundant world powered by a 100% clean energy economy for 100% of the population in the shortest time possible.
We support diverse entrepreneurs to drive innovation and build equity in the global clean energy ecosystem. Our ambitious goal is to help 100,000 clean energy startups succeed by 2030. We offer a mission-driven, collaborative, and flexible environment for professionals committed to accelerating the transition to clean energy.

ROLE OVERVIEW
We are seeking an experienced, detail-oriented Part-Time Regional Accountant to support financial operations across Singapore and Vietnam. This is a fully remote independent contractor engagement open to candidates based in the China, Philippines, Indonesia, or Malaysia.
The role is focused on high-quality financial execution, including maintaining accurate books in QuickBooks Online (QBO), mapping financial data prepared by local accounting partners, completing reconciliations and foreign currency translations, and preparing information for group-level reporting and consolidation.
You will report to the Financial Lead, who retains responsibility for strategic finance decisions, high-level compliance, and final audit sign-offs. This opportunity is best suited to an experienced accountant who enjoys hands-on work, multi-entity accounting, and independently managing recurring deliverables.

ENGAGEMENT, SCHEDULE AND COMPENSATION
- Engagement type: Independent contractor.
- Location: Fully remote. Applicants must be based in the Philippines, Indonesia, or Malaysia. Some on-site work might be done for applicants based in Shanghai.
- Rate: USD 15.00 per hour, based on actual approved working hours recorded through monthly timesheets.
- Schedule: Flexible, with workload concentrated around month-end close, statutory filing deadlines, and annual audit requirements.
- Collaboration hours: The contractor must be able to maintain reliable overlap with the Financial Lead during Singapore/Shanghai business hours, generally within 10:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Shanghai/Singapore time when work is scheduled.

Work Hours:
- Standard months (-9 months/year; January - March & July - December): Approximately 40 to 80 hours per month. Capped at 80 hours/month.
- Audit period (-3 months/year; April to June): Full-time dedicated capacity. 8 hours per workday capped at 160 hours/month.
- Any hours exceeding the monthly ceiling require prior written approval from the Financial Lead.

Availability and focus requirement: This engagement requires the contractor's full professional attention during agreed working hours. Contractors may have other clients or projects, provided those commitments do not overlap with scheduled NEX work. This role is not intended to be performed as a side job alongside another full-time position.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Financial Accounting and Bookkeeping
- Maintain full-charge bookkeeping for three Singapore entities in QuickBooks Online using established internal accounting processes.
- Process journal entries, categorize transactions, and complete monthly bank, balance sheet, and general ledger reconciliations.
- Perform quarterly foreign currency translations from SGD to USD for the designated entity using approved exchange rates.
- Identify discrepancies, unusual balances, and data-quality issues, and resolve or escalate them promptly.

Vietnam Financial Data Management
- Review monthly financial statements prepared by the local Vietnamese accounting partner.
- Perform data-quality checks and map financial information to the established internal Chart of Accounts.
- Complete VND-to-USD foreign currency translations using approved rates.
- Upload accurate, mapped financial data into the relevant QuickBooks Online accounts.

Compliance and Audit Support
- Gather financial data and prepare supporting documentation for Singapore statutory filings, including corporate tax filings, ACRA annual returns, and FATCA-related requirements.
- Support the annual audit by preparing audit schedules, pulling QBO reports, completing reconciliations, and organizing requested documentation.
- Maintain clear, complete, and audit-ready financial records in the company's document-management systems.

Reporting and Additional Support
- Prepare and review quarterly financial information used to track the performance of Singapore investment vehicles.
- Support the Financial Lead with accounting analysis, reporting, and other finance tasks as needed.

Requirements:
REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS
- Bachelor's degree or higher in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
- At least five (5) years of progressive accounting or bookkeeping experience.
- Strong, hands-on expertise in QuickBooks Online. This is essential for the role.
- Advanced Excel skills, including lookups, conditional formulas, multi-tab data mapping, and reconciliations.
- Strong practical understanding of accounting principles under IFRS and/or GAAP.
- Excellent written English skills for documentation, reporting, and remote collaboration.
- Demonstrated ability to independently manage recurring deadlines and deliver accurate work without continuous oversight.
- Comfort using digital workflow and collaboration tools as part of a fully remote team.
- Highly methodical, organized, and attentive to detail, with strong problem-solving skills.

PREFERRED EXPERIENCE
- Experience supporting multiple legal entities or international organizations.
- Experience with Singapore accounting, statutory reporting, or audit requirements.
- Experience reviewing and mapping financial information prepared by external accounting firms.
- Experience with foreign currency translation and group-level reporting.
- Mandarin language skills, spoken and/or written.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE
The successful contractor will maintain accurate and timely books, complete reconciliations and data uploads with minimal correction, keep financial documentation organized and audit-ready, communicate issues early, and reliably meet month-end and audit deadlines while working independently.

title: IT Cyber Security Manager
description_text:
We are seeking a seasoned Cyber Security to own the end-to-end cybersecurity posture of the organization. This is a senior leadership role responsible for protecting a complex hybrid-cloud environment and converged IT/OT landscape (including manufacturing, IoT, and SCADA/ICS systems), while building and leading a high-performing security function across people, process, and technology. The role carries direct accountability for translating technical risk into business language for the C-Suite and Board of Directors.
• Define and lead the enterprise cybersecurity strategy and roadmap, aligning security investment with business risk and budget priorities.
• Build and mature a Zero Trust and SASE architecture, including ZTNA, micro-segmentation, and cloud-native secure access (CASB, FWaaS, SWG).
• Own security for converged IT/OT environments, applying the Purdue Model to segment industrial networks and manage ICS/SCADA security posture.
• Establish and scale an AI-driven Security Operations Center (SOC), integrating UEBA, AI-powered SOAR playbook automation, and proactive threat detection mapped to MITRE ATT&CK.
• Lead identity and endpoint security strategy: self-healing Unified Endpoint Management (UEM), passwordless authentication (FIDO2), and dynamic Privileged Access Management (PAM).
• Drive secure software delivery by embedding Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM), Kubernetes security, and automated DAST/SAST scanning into CI/CD pipelines.
• Govern enterprise risk and compliance across ISO 27001:2022, NIST CSF 2.0, CIS Controls v8, PCI-DSS, TISAX, DORA, and applicable privacy regulations (e.g., GDPR, Indonesia's PDP Law).
• Report cybersecurity risk, incidents, and program maturity to the C-Suite and Board in clear, quantifiable financial and business terms.
• Recruit, mentor, and lead the security team; manage security budget, vendor relationships, and third-party risk.
• Own incident response planning, crisis management, and post-incident review for security events across IT and OT domains.

Requirements:
• 12–15+ years of progressive enterprise cybersecurity experience, including significant time in a senior leadership capacity.
• Proven track record leading holistic security transformations spanning budget, people, and technology.
• Deep, hands-on expertise in Zero Trust architecture, SASE, and modern network security controls.
• Practical experience securing IT/OT convergence, manufacturing facilities, IoT, and industrial control systems.
• Strong background in AI-driven SecOps, SOAR automation, and threat intelligence operations.
• Working mastery of global governance frameworks: ISO 27001:2022, NIST CSF 2.0, CIS Controls v8, PCI-DSS, TISAX, DORA, and GDPR.
• Demonstrated ability to communicate technical cyber risk to non-technical executive and Board audiences.
• Bachelor's degree in Information Security, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field; advanced degree a plus.

Preferred Certification
- CISSP — Certified Information Systems Security Professional
- CISM — Certified Information Security Manager
- CISA — Certified Information Systems Auditor
- GICSP — Global Industrial Cyber Security Professional
- CCSP — Certified Cloud Security Professional
- CRISC — Certified in Risk and Information Systems Control
- GIAC GDSA — Defensible Security Architecture
- CEH / OSCP

title: Offensive Security Engineer/Lead
description_text:
Founded to transform retail finance, Ajaib Group is an Indonesian fintech unicorn breaking barriers to financial access. Having recently secured a $270M Series C—the single largest funding round in Southeast Asia over the past four years—we are backed by premier global investors including Y Combinator, Ribbit Capital, SoftBank, and SBI Holdings.
To build world-class products, we assemble world-class talent. Supported by our fully remote work arrangement, our team spans Eastern Europe, the Middle East, India, and Southeast Asia, allowing you to work with brilliant engineers and builders from around the globe from wherever you are. We operate with an impact-driven purpose where everyone is the owner of our customers' satisfaction. Driven by a growth mindset and a fierce will to win, we refuse to settle and constantly push engineering boundaries.

Role Overview
As the Offensive Security Engineer/Lead, you will spearhead our adversarial simulation, penetration testing, and vulnerability research programs to proactively identify and neutralize security weaknesses. Reporting directly to the Head of Security, you will design and execute sophisticated Red Team campaigns, simulate real-world cyber adversary behaviors, and validate our detection capabilities. You will be responsible for operationalizing threat intelligence by mapping all simulation activities directly to the MITRE ATT&CK framework and the Lockheed Martin Cyber Kill Chain.

Key Responsibilities
- Offensive Security Program Leadership: Define the strategy, scope, and execution roadmap for enterprise-wide penetration testing, red teaming, and adversary simulation exercises.
- Adversary Simulation & MITRE Mapping: Design and execute complex, multi-stage red team operations that emulate real-world Threat Actors and Advanced Persistent Threats (APTs), meticulously mapping techniques to the MITRE ATT&CK Framework.
- Cyber Kill Chain Validation: Evaluate the efficacy of our security posture across every phase of the Lockheed Martin Cyber Kill Chain (Reconnaissance to Actions on Objectives), identifying gaps in boundary defenses and internal monitoring.
- Purple Teaming Collaboration: Partner closely with the Blue Team (SOC and Incident Response) to conduct Purple Team exercises, using simulation data to refine detection engineering, SIEM alerts, and response playbooks.
- Vulnerability Exploitation & Reporting: Safely exploit vulnerabilities across network infrastructure, cloud environments, and applications. Translate complex technical proof-of-concepts into actionable, risk-prioritized remediation reports for engineering teams.
- Tooling Innovation: Oversee the development, deployment, and safe operation of proprietary offensive security tools, scripts, and command-and-control (C2) frameworks.

Requirements:
- Experience: 8+ years of dedicated technical experience in offensive security, ethical hacking, or penetration testing, with at least 2+ years leading a red team or offensive security function.
- Framework Expert: Mastery of the MITRE ATT&CK matrix (Enterprise, Cloud, and Mobile) and deep conceptual understanding of the Lockheed Martin Cyber Kill Chain methodology.
- Technical Environment: Proficient with commercial and open-source offensive tools (e.g., Cobalt Strike, Burp Suite, Metasploit) and deep familiarity with cloud-native security landscapes (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
- Scripting & Exploitation: Strong scripting/programming skills (e.g., Python, Go, PowerShell, Bash) to automate attacks, bypass security controls, and develop custom exploits.
- Certifications: Possession of advanced offensive security certifications such as OSCE, OSEP, OSWE, GXPN, or CRTO (Certified Red Team Operator) is highly preferred.
- Communication: Exceptional communication skills with a proven track record of explaining complex attack vectors and business impacts to both deeply technical engineers and non-technical business executives.

title: Lead, DevSecOps Engineer
description_text:

Role Overview
As a DevSecOps Engineer, you will bridge the gap between development, operations, and information security. Reporting to the Application Security Lead, you will architect, maintain, and scale security automation across our software development lifecycles (SDLC). Your primary mandate is to shift security left by embedding SAST, DAST, and SCA tools directly into modern CI/CD pipelines, eliminating security bottlenecks and ensuring continuous code compliance.

Key Responsibilities
- Pipeline Security Automation: Integrate and manage static, dynamic, and software composition analysis tools into continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD) pipelines.
- Tooling Optimization: Own, configure, and fine-tune AppSec platforms including Checkmarx, Semgrep, Snyk, and SonarQube to minimize false positives and maximize actionable alerts.
- Automated & Manual DAST: Configure automated dynamic scanners and leverage Burp Suite Professional for targeted security testing on APIs and web services.
- Vulnerability Remediation & Triage: Act as the primary technical point of contact to triage code vulnerabilities, providing clear remediation guidance and proof-of-concept fixes directly to engineering teams.
- Open Source Security (SCA): Utilize Snyk and similar tools to monitor open-source dependencies, license compliance, and third-party software supply chain vulnerabilities.
- Policy Enforcement: Define automated gatekeeping thresholds (e.g., failing builds for critical/high vulnerabilities) within the deployment pipeline based on internal security policies.

Requirements:
- Experience: 4+ years of experience in DevOps, software engineering, or application security, with at least 2+ years dedicated exclusively to DevSecOps practices.
- Tooling Command: Proven, deep technical proficiency with the following tools:
- SAST: Checkmarx, Semgrep, SonarQube
- SCA & Container Security: Snyk
- DAST / Pen-testing: Burp Suite Professional
- CI/CD Ecosystems: Extensive experience building automation plugins and pipelines in GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, or Bitbucket Pipelines.
- Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Solid understanding of cloud-native infrastructure, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and secure IaC deployment (Terraform).
- Development Background: Ability to read and understand code snippets across multiple languages (e.g., Python, Java, Go, Node.js).

title: QA Engineer
description_text:
Company Summary:
Since 2002, DVI Solutions has been a leading provider of audio-visual setups to help our clients communicate and collaborate better--whether it's with colleagues across the office, or partners on the other side of the world. We have presence across Japan, Singapore, Thailand, Shanghai, Hong Kong, Philippines, Vietnam, India, Malaysia and Indonesia. Our satisfied clients include corporations, government agencies, schools, retail stores, hotels and many more.

Role Overview
We are seeking a detail-oriented and proactive QA Engineer to ensure the quality, reliability, and performance of our SaaS platform. This role combines hands-on manual testing with test automation development and requires close collaboration with Product, Engineering, DevOps, and Security teams.
The ideal candidate embraces a "Shift-Left" testing approach, actively participating throughout the software development lifecycle to identify defects early and improve overall product quality. You will be responsible for designing and maintaining automated test frameworks, executing comprehensive testing strategies, and supporting continuous delivery practices.

Key Responsibilities
Test Automation & Quality Engineering
- Design, develop, and maintain scalable automated test frameworks using Playwright.
- Create and execute API test suites using Postman and Newman to validate backend services and integrations.
- Integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines to support rapid and reliable software releases.
- Develop and maintain test plans, test cases, and testing documentation.
- Monitor automation coverage, test execution results, and quality metrics to drive continuous improvement.
Manual & Exploratory Testing
- Perform functional, regression, integration, exploratory, and smoke testing for new and existing features.
- Validate user workflows, edge cases, and system behavior across various scenarios.
- Conduct cross-browser and responsive web application testing.
- Execute targeted manual testing for high-risk features, integrations, and media processing workflows.
Agile Collaboration & Defect Management
- Participate in sprint planning, backlog grooming, requirement reviews, and design discussions to identify quality risks early.
- Collaborate closely with developers to ensure testability and quality are embedded within the development process.
- Investigate, reproduce, document, and track defects through to resolution.
- Provide clear and actionable feedback to stakeholders regarding product quality and release readiness.
Security & Compliance
- Support security testing initiatives by collaborating with DevOps and Security teams.
- Work with automated security scanning tools such as SonarQube, Snyk, Aikido, or equivalent solutions.
- Ensure testing processes and documentation align with compliance requirements, including SOC 2 standards where applicable.
- Assist in validating system security, data protection, and access control requirements.

Requirements:
Must-Have Technical Skills (Hands-On Experience)
- Minimum 4 years of experience in Software Quality Assurance.
- At least 1 year of hands-on experience developing and maintaining automated test frameworks.
- Strong experience with Playwright for UI test automation.
- Hands-on experience with Postman and API testing methodologies.
- Proven experience in executing smoke testing, functional testing, regression testing, integration testing, and exploratory testing throughout the software development lifecycle.

Additional Requirements
- Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and automated test integration.
- Experience with Git version control and Agile development practices.
- Good understanding of web technologies, REST APIs, and modern software architecture.
- Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to identify root causes of issues.
- Excellent attention to detail and commitment to delivering high-quality software.

Why Join us
- Opportunities to work on regional projects with global brands.
- Exposure to multinational clients, cross-border teams, and cutting-edge technology.
- Exposure to solutions that include immersive video walls, hybrid meeting tech, collaboration tech, digital transformation, smart workspace integration and much more.
- Team-oriented culture that encourages collaboration and continuous learning.
- Involved in custom projects for high-profile clients, DVI offers opportunities to expand your portfolio and build a specialized skill set.
- A booming industry with the rise of hybrid workspaces and smart office solutions.

title: Affiliate Marketing Specialist (Creator Commerce)
description_text:
Format: Remote
Duration: 3-months fixed-term contract

About the Role
We’re looking for an Affiliate Marketing Specialist (Creator Commerce) to support a new creator commerce programme in a few local markets across APAC.
You’ll work with creator agencies, networks and creators to build a strong pipeline of affiliate content around selected products and categories.
This is not traditional influencer marketing. Creators will retain significant freedom over how they make the content rather than working from highly prescriptive campaign briefs. Your role is to identify the right creators, activate participation, keep content supply moving and help ensure the programme produces enough quality content for stronger-performing work to emerge.
Once content is live, performance signals will help identify videos with stronger organic commercial potential. You’ll support the review of shortlisted content, using sound marketing judgement to assess quality, relevance and brand suitability before the strongest work progresses through the programme.
Success in this role means building a reliable pipeline of relevant creators and commercially credible affiliate content in your market, while helping improve the programme as it evolves.
Creator & Agency Partnerships
- Activate or build relationships with creator agencies, MCNs and creator networks in your market.
- Identify creators whose existing content, audience and category expertise align with selected products.
- Explain the programme clearly and help activate creator participation.
- Build a consistent pipeline of suitable creators and maintain momentum across the programme.
Affiliate Content Supply & Quality
- Strong understanding of the strategic value of affiliate marketing for brands, including driving performance-based ROI, lowering Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC), and generating scalable social proof.
- Deep grasp of the commercial models driving creator commerce, including how creators earn commission (CPA/CPS), how platforms monetize transactions (fees/take rates), and how brands calculate profit margins.
- Coordinate creator participation and content delivery across agreed products and categories.
- Help ensure creators understand product-tagging and affiliate requirements without over-prescribing the creative.
- Review content against agreed quality and suitability standards.
- Use marketing judgement to identify content that feels credible, commercially relevant and appropriate for further review.
- Balance quality with scale so the programme does not become overly restrictive or operationally heavy.
Performance & Programme Coordination
- Track creators, products, content and delivery status.
- Work with available performance signals to understand which content shows stronger organic commercial potential.
- Support the identification of high-potential content for further review and potential amplification.
- Maintain accurate records and provide clear updates on creator participation and content supply.
- Bring local market insight and affiliate-commerce knowledge into the evolving programme design.
- Proven project management experience, with the ability to build workflows, manage timelines, and coordinate multiple stakeholders (brands, creator networks, and internal teams) to keep high-volume content pipelines organized.

About You
- You have approximately 1-3 years of experience across affiliate marketing, creator commerce, social commerce, influencer marketing, e-commerce, digital marketing or creator partnerships.
- You understand how affiliate creators and product-tagging ecosystems work.
- Experience with platforms such as TikTok Shop, YouTube Shopping or similar creator-commerce environments would be highly relevant.
- You are comfortable working directly with clients/brands, creator agencies, creators and external partners.
- You understand what makes creator content commercially credible rather than simply high-volume.
- You have good marketing judgement and can recognise the difference between low-quality affiliate content and content that genuinely has the potential to influence purchase.
- You are comfortable looking at basic performance indicators and using them to inform decisions.
- You understand your local creator and social commerce landscape.
- You are fluent in the relevant local language and comfortable working in English across a regional team.
- You are organised, proactive and confident enough to build relationships while still being detail-oriented.
- You are comfortable working in a new programme where some processes will continue to evolve.

Please Note
Due to the high volume of applications, we unfortunately can’t get back to everyone, and only successful applicants will be contacted. When you share your details with us, we consider this as consent for us to use your data during the application process. We may implement AI in various stages of the recruitment process, but human involvement will always remain as part of our hiring ethos. At the moment, MASH is not in a position to sponsor work visas, so you have to be eligible to legally work in the country where we’re hiring.
